title: Functional integrated hydrogel with swelling–adhesion, antibacterial and conductive properties for acute wound hemostasis and diagnosis-treatment integration
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,19674-19686
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA01581F, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Qin Wang, Linfeng Shi, Yuqin Li, Xiuyu Liang, Zhongnan Wang, Gui Ma, Enke Feng, Zhiming Yang, Lili Tian
A multifunctional composite hydrogel was developed, demonstrating improved hemostatic and antibacterial properties for improved wound healing while sensing wound exudate and tearing. This material shows promise as a multifunctional smart dressing.
